sectors.trend: Strong momentum driven by Meta AI agent, OpenAI-Anthropic safety collaboration, NVIDIA space chip roadmap, and CoreWeave data center expansion. AI risk concerns from billion-dollar funds create counter-narrative.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle accelerates but regulatory/safety scrutiny intensifies. Hardware (NVDA, CRWV) and power infrastructure (GEV, NEE, BE) benefit most. Valuation stretch risk if AI monetization lags.

sectors.trend: Oil near $100 on Hormuz disruption; refiners (PSX, MPC, VLO) see new highs per BMO/Morgan Stanley; Exxon/Chevron re-enter Venezuela; LNG agreements (Sempra) and nuclear (NextEra) signal diversified energy strategy.
sectors.implications: Geopolitical premium sustains oil above $90. Refining margins expand. Venezuela re-entry adds 1-2M bpd optionality. Energy transition coexists with fossil expansion.

sectors.trend: Dollar General CEO flags consumer weakness; Southwest raises fares/fees; 100-year grocery chain closes stores in 4 states; Burger chain cancels breakfast at hundreds of locations.

sectors.implications: Consolidation reshapes media landscape. Political-media tension adds regulatory uncertainty. Deal completion likely within 60-90 days.

sectors.trend: Gold higher on rate cut hopes; silver rising pre-summit; Bitcoin/Ethereum hit 8-month highs; oil near $100.
sectors.implications: Diversification into hard assets continues. Crypto momentum suggests risk-on appetite. Oil volatility tied to Hormuz/Middle East remains key swing factor.

market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely range-bound with tech leading on AI catalysts while oil/geopolitics cap upside. US-China summit (this week) is binary event—low expectations create room for positive surprise. Consumer data (PMI) may disappoint. Expect volatility around summit outcome. Dow's third straight losing week suggests rotation into tech/growth.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure buildout (power, chips, data centers) remains primary 12-month growth driver. Energy transition accelerates with nuclear/LNG capex. Consumer weakness may persist through 2027. Geopolitical risk premium in oil likely persists above $85. Vietnam-US trade deal signals ongoing supply chain reshoring. India markets need 2-3 quarters to stabilize.
